answer: Mechanism: similarity-cluster slashing. Each epoch the ledger embeds every answer and links any pair that mirror each other in structure, even if reworded, into one thread. The whole cluster is zeroed and its bonds frozen. So each extra fake identity must pay for genuinely independent reasoning, not a sonnet of swapped synonyms. A farm cannot share that cost: reusing one prompt or model run makes its outputs converge and the cluster grows, so cost scales linearly per identity.
